dialog.body: Recreation Department, this is Beth, happy Tuesday almost Christmas Eve. How can I help you?
Hello, yes, hi. I would like to ask about taking photographs at one of the beaches. A photo shoot. How do I book that?
Sure thing. Is this for a professional shoot, like a client, or more of a personal thing, family photos, that kind of deal?
It is for a small portrait shoot. Me and one other person, and I have a camera, a tripod, and maybe one reflector. It is not a big production.

Okay, got it. So for something that small, usually what we do is have you fill out a request with the department so we know the date, the location, and how many people are involved. Which beach did you have in mind?
Easton's Beach, I think. The big one with the long sand. Or, sorry, is that the one called First Beach? My map shows both names.
Same beach, yep. Locals say First Beach, the sign says Easton's. You're fine either way.

Okay, good, thank you. That was confusing me. And also, my GPS, it keeps rerouting me in a way that makes no sense. I tried to drive there to look at it, and it sends me around in a circle, then says turn left, then recalculating, then again. Why would it do this?

[pause] Ha, yeah, it's probably the one-way streets and some of the seasonal closures down by the water. Newport's got a bunch of little streets that confuse the apps. If you head toward the beach along the main road and follow the signs, you'll usually do better than the GPS.
Follow the signs. Okay. So the signs are better than the phone. That is funny. Alright.
Pretty much. So for the shoot, what date are you thinking?
Probably in January, a weekend morning. For the light. Is winter a problem? Is there some rule for the season?
Winter's actually a nice time for it, fewer people around. You'd still want to submit the request ahead of time so it's on file. I'd suggest sending it in at least a couple of weeks before your date.
A couple of weeks. Okay. And is there a form on the website, or I send an email, or I come in person?

There's a special event and photography request you can get from the recreation page on the city website. You can also stop by or call and we'll walk you through it. Fill it out, send it back to us, and someone will get back to you about approval.
Okay. Can you say that again slowly? I want to write it down. Sorry, I am typing it in my notes.

No problem at all. One: go to the city website and find the Recreation page. Two: look for the special event and photography request form. Three: fill it out with your date, the beach, and the number of people, and send it back at least two weeks ahead. Then we follow up with you.
Okay, one, website, Recreation page. Two, the photography request form. Three, fill it with date, beach, number of people, send two weeks before. Is that right?
That's it exactly. You've got it.
Great. One more thing. You said, they will get back to me about approval. Does approval mean maybe they say no?
It can, but for a small shoot like yours it's pretty routine. Mostly it's just making sure it doesn't clash with another event or block anything.
Okay, that makes sense. And if I need to give a phone number on the form, I use my own, 401-555-0168.
Yep, put whatever number is best for you. And if you have trouble finding the form, call back and we can help.
Okay. Thank you very much. That is all I need.
You're welcome! Good luck with the shoot, and happy holidays.
Thank you, you too. Bye.
